representative_selection: Each baseline and checkpoint/mode group: most recoveries, then most pieces, then lowest seed/action seed.
limitations: Four distinct game seeds provide bounded evidence; sampled action repeats are averaged within seed, not 12 independent game seeds.
Game histories and sampled choices differ across policies despite common seed values.
Generation comparison includes target recovery and residual-policy differences; it does not isolate the training algorithm.
Piece-cap survivors are censored at 32000 placements and do not prove indefinite survival.
Throughput is sequential game wall time including recording; loading and warm-up are excluded.
Replay count/hash/mask validation is distinct from physics reconstruction; see representative_physics status.
No automatic model promotion or GUI default change; later tuning on these seeds needs a separate untouched final test.
